provenance.corpus: Isolated owner account containing four manually reviewed business-policy documents synchronized from the configured Google Drive folder.
provenance.execution: Live FastAPI retrieval and LangGraph chat endpoints backed by PostgreSQL and pgvector.
provenance.privacy: Aggregate results only. Credentials, raw document content, generated answers, judge rationales, and per-query retrieval records are intentionally excluded.

limitations: The corpus and dataset are small and designed for this project.
The same model generated answers and judged the five qualitative dimensions.
One run is a regression baseline, not a production quality guarantee.
Strict chunk and citation precision count only manually selected gold chunks, so neighboring relevant chunks are treated as non-gold.
